From BusinessWeek
November 23, 1998

Up Front: AFTERLIVES

DIVE-BOMBER IN THE WAR ON DRUGS

AS CEO OF JOHNSON & JOHNSON during the 1982 tainted Tylenol scare,

See
The Media Switch From Promiscuity To Prostitution.
Program Content To Reflect Prohibitionist Party Line To Get Government Ads
and
"The government’s relationships to the media industry, and to the public, are changing."
and
Magazine Publishers of America Agree To Feature Prohibitionist Propaganda In Content
To Get Share of $775 Million Ad Campaign

(Marijuananews note: Remember this when you hear about the "millions" spent on the medical marijuana initiatives. The PDFA’s budget – never mind the free ads – exceeds that of all the anti-prohibitionist organizations combined.)

"I’m not really working," he says. "I’m having a good time." There’s reason to feel good: Drug use is down, though high-school-age kids remain a troubling exception. If Burke can reach those teens with spots on Dawson’s Creek, use could slide there, too, though no solid link can be claimed. Says Burke: "Attitudes drive behavior."

By Joseph Weber
